load_bearing_assumption: Rc/Rc0 = P0/P: the coating (pore) resistance improvement equals the permeability-reduction (tortuosity) factor, valid for an ideal defect-free two-phase film of impermeable platelets in an ionically-resistive matrix. Defects, active inhibition, cathodic delamination and cure-state effects are outside this idealisation.

verdict.advance_over_prior: barrier-null-char-v1 showed only that MONOTONE nulls fail on optimum location. This adds the first PHYSICAL named baselines, quantifies WHY they fail (interior optimum = dispersion/agglomeration beyond continuum tortuosity), and adds a NEW falsifiable a-priori discriminator: the effective-aspect-ratio inversion separates tortuosity-consistent (graphene) from tortuosity-insufficient (clay) initial barrier gains.
verdict.does_not_establish: A validated positive barrier ranking model. The interior optimum -- the part of the signal that beats a monotone predictor -- is driven by dispersion/agglomeration, a formulation-processing variable no zero-parameter continuum-tortuosity model can capture. Closing that still needs >=3 pooled, protocol-controlled formulation->Rc series with dispersion/PVC metadata (the standing DATA wall).
verdict.finding: Two published a-priori platelet-tortuosity barrier models (Nielsen 1967, Cussler 1988), parameterised with published densities and aspect-ratio ceilings and NOT fit to Rc, are STRUCTURALLY REFUTED on optimum LOCATION for both strict in-class epoxy-amine ladders: both are monotone in phi and predict best barrier at maximum loading, whereas both series peak at an interior loading. On the level-0 -> optimum INITIAL RISE the two fillers diverge: the clay ladder (asperti2024) demands an effective aspect ratio ABOVE the published montmorillonite ceiling (tortuosity insufficient to explain the initial jump alone), while the graphene ladder (zhu2022) is reproducible within the published graphene aspect-ratio range (tortuosity a sufficient a-priori explanation of its initial rise; mica-base confound noted, secondary).
verdict.scope_honesty: Organic epoxy-amine coating-barrier EIS, correct module scope.
